instruction: Please configure VS Code to set the font size to 16 for the current user.

metadata.explanation: Task requires agent to configure VS Code font size setting to 16. Evaluator checks the settings.json file for the correct key-value pair. Uses existing check_json_settings metric.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly fetches VS Code user settings file from standard Linux location (/home/user/.config/Code/User/settings.json)
Metric check_json_settings correctly loads JSON and verifies key-value pairs with exact matching
Expected value uses correct VS Code setting key 'editor.fontSize' with correct value 16
Evaluator provides complete coverage of instruction requirement (setting font size to 16)
Data flow is correct: getter extracts settings file, metric compares JSON content, expected value matches requirement
No postconfig needed - VS Code persists settings to disk automatically when changed
Metric handles edge cases properly (missing file, missing keys, None values)

rule_validation_issues.msg: metric check_json_settings first parameter type (str) may not match getter get_vm_file return type (Union)
metric check_json_settings second parameter type (str) may not match expected.rules type (Dict)
